name: Warehouse — Energy Management
tagline: Balance order fulfillment with battery recharging at the charging station.
narrative:
Night shift in the warehouse!

Your robot has a 60-unit battery. Every step, pickup, and delivery drains energy. If the battery runs out, the robot stops mid-aisle and the shift fails!

Fortunately, a charging bay sits along the main aisle loop. Add a battery management rule: when standing on the charger (chargingHere) and energy is low (energy < 40), perform a charge action before resuming deliveries!
objective: Deliver all station orders while managing the robot's finite battery.
learningObjective: Interrupt routine tasks safely when resource thresholds (energy < 40) require maintenance.
intelligenceExplanation:
The starter brain includes pickup and delivery rules. Add a charging rule:
WHEN chargingHere && energy < 40 -> DO charge

Place this charging rule above navigation rules so the robot recharges when low on battery while passing the charging bay.
hint: Add WHEN chargingHere && energy < 40 -> DO charge above navigation.
hints: The charging bay is located along the main aisle loop.
Combine chargingHere with an energy threshold (e.g. energy < 40) so the robot charges only when needed.
Place the charging rule above navigation rules.
brief: Complete the 6-order shift while monitoring battery levels and recharging when needed.
context: Every move and action drains battery. If energy reaches 0, the robot stops dead in the aisle.
